name: @kition/kits-mcp
instructions: Kition kits edit workspace files that are not text: no kit is installed. Kits that are not installed cannot be installed now: the kit index cannot be read (cannot reach https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KitionAI/kition-sdk/kits-index/kits-index.json: io: failed to lookup address information: Temporary failure in name resolution). Ask the person to connect, or to run `kition kit install <kit>`, then restart this server. For a file, call its kit's `<kit>_inspect` first, find commands with `<kit>_commands`, then edit with `<kit>_run`; check the preview it returns. Kits with an object model also offer `<kit>_query` (read objects by id or by following fields from the root) and `<kit>_batch` (edit them in one model/batch), and their objects as `kit://` resources. After editing, call `<kit>_check` to list what the kit finds wrong with the file (each diagnostic has a stable `code`, a `severity`, a `target`, and maybe a `fix` command) and fix the errors. Failed calls answer `error.code` (for example `not-found`, `read-only`, `unknown-command`) and `error.index`. Answers on a file carry `revision`: pass the latest one as `basis` on your next call on it, and the answer lists what others changed since (`others`); a write refused with `conflict` ran nothing because others deleted, moved or changed what it acts on: look at `others` and `conflicts`, then decide again. A file open in Kition is edited live in its editor.
stderr: kition mcp: workspace /pkg (the current folder; --workspace names another)
